character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A short bull with a rider on top holding a hammer

rows.animation: The bull rider shifts his weight slightly as he raises the hammer, pulling it back behind his shoulder before swinging it forward in a forceful, downward arc. As he strikes, the bull jerks its head and shoulders upward in response to the sudden movement, causing the rider to lean forward with the momentum of the swing. After the impact, the rider pulls the hammer back to his side, and both the rider and the bull settle back into their original, steady stance.
